Privacy Policy

Last updated: April 2026

Who We Are

AI Tool Guru is an independent review site operated by Piceras Group Ltd. We provide honest reviews and recommendations of AI tools for UK small businesses.

What Data We Collect

We collect minimal data to operate this website:

  • Analytics: We use privacy-focused analytics to understand how visitors use our site. This data is anonymised and does not identify you personally.
  • Newsletter: If you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address. You can unsubscribe at any time.
  • Cookies: We use cookies to remember your theme preference (light/dark mode) and to improve your browsing experience.

Affiliate Links

Some links on this site are affiliate links. This means we may earn a commission if you click through and make a purchase. This does not affect the price you pay. We only recommend tools we have tested and believe in.

Third-Party Services

We may use third-party services for hosting, analytics, and email delivery. These services may collect data in accordance with their own privacy policies.

Your Rights

Under UK data protection law, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Object to processing of your data
  • Request restriction of processing
  • Request transfer of your data

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at hello@aitoolguru.co.uk.
